title: Filipino-Style Pork Blood Stew
description: A traditional Filipino dish made with pork blood, meat, and organs, slow-cooked in a rich savory broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sear the pork organs until browned, then set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and sauté until softened.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the pork blood and cooked pork organs back to the pot.
Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Simmer the mixture over low heat for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
